transformation_history.net_effect: The privacy redaction (the region above) is the only substantive pixel-content change between the governed source and the retained image. The RGBA-to-RGB mode change is a lossless, visually-inert format change given the source's uniform opacity, not a second content transformation.
transformation_history.verification: Independently confirmed this bounded-correction session via direct PIL/NumPy inspection: source mode == 'RGBA', retained mode == 'RGB', source alpha array min == max == 255, and an RGB-channel-only pixel-diff between source and retained showing zero changed pixels outside the declared redaction rectangle.
